verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at external event ingestion: a 'Webhooks' docs page (title only) and CEL 'event filters', which suggest events can come from outside and be filtered. Nothing shows a signal, event, or message being delivered to a specific already-running workflow instance. Missing for 10: documentation of delivering events or signals to a specific running workflow (e.g., wait-for-event or durable event APIs), API or SDK examples for sending such signals, workflow-to-workflow signaling, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
